    • findAllByLandlordPublicIdFetchCoverPicture

      @Query("SELECT listing FROM Listing listing LEFT JOIN FETCH listing.pictures picture WHERE listing.landlordPublicId = :landlordPublicId AND picture.isCover = true") List<Listing> findAllByLandlordPublicIdFetchCoverPicture(UUID landlordPublicId)
      Finds all listings for a landlord, fetching only the cover picture for each listing.
      Parameters:
      landlordPublicId - the UUID of the landlord
      Returns:
      a list of Listing entities with cover pictures
